description: Description of Link Count's functionality. Shown as a short description at the top of the page and in search results.
nav-skip: Hidden link that allows keyboard users to skip to the tool's results.
lang-select-label: Tooltip for the language selection dropdown that controls the interface language.
form-project: Label for the project input field in the form. This is where users enter the URL of the Wikimedia project they want to analyze.
form-page: Label for the page input field in the form. This is where users enter the name of the page they want to analyze.
form-namespaces: Label for the namespaces input field in the form. This is where users can specify which namespaces to include in the analysis.
form-submit: Text for the submit button in the form.
table-header-type: Header for the 'Type' column in the results table. This column indicates the type of link (wikilink, redirect, etc.).
table-header-all: Header for the 'All' column in the results table. This column shows the total number of links for each type.
table-header-direct: Header for the 'Direct' column in the results table. This column shows the number of pages that link to the analyzed page through a redirect.
table-header-direct-tooltip: Tooltip that explains the 'Direct' column in the results table.
table-header-indirect: Header for the 'Indirect' column in the results table. This column shows the number of pages that link to the analyzed page directly using it's name (rather than through a redirect).
table-header-indirect-tooltip: Tooltip that explains the 'Indirect' column in the results table.
action-link-to-row: Tooltip for a small button that allows users to add a link to the current table row to the clipboard.
link-type-filelinks: Label for the row that shows the number of file links. Should be concise.
link-type-categorylinks: Label for the row that shows the number of category links. Should be concise.
link-type-wikilinks: Label for the row that shows the number of wikilinks (standard internal links). Should be concise.
link-type-redirects: Label for the row that shows the number of redirects. Should be concise.
link-type-transclusions: Label for the row that shows the number of transclusions (pages that use this page as a template). Should be concise.
link-what-links-here: Link to the MediaWiki '{{msg-mw|whatlinkshere-title}}' special page for the analyzed page. Should probably be '{{msg-mw|whatlinkshere}}'.
footer-form: Link to the form page for Link Count.
footer-api: Link to the API page for Link Count.
footer-created-by: Text indicating who authored/created Link Count. $1 is a placeholder for the author's name.
error-page-required: Error shown when the user submits the form without entering a page name.
error-invalid-namespace-ids: Error shown when the user submits the form with invalid namespace IDs.
error-nonexistent-project: Error shown when the user submits the form with a non-existent MediaWiki project.
